_verify: Pattern from GATE 2027 Information Brochure (gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern): 65 Q, 100 marks (GA 15 + subject 85), 180 min; MCQ negative 1/3 (1-mark) and 2/3 (2-mark); no negative for MSQ/NAT; no partial marking in MSQ. Per-type counts are taken from the GATE 2026 DA paper (session 8) and VARY year to year (2024: 17/2/6 + 10/10/... , see docs/13_GATE_DA.md); check the 2027 paper. Fractional negatives are stored as decimals; core scoring accepts any number. NAT answers are ranges {range:[lo,hi]}; MSQ is all-or-nothing (core MSQ rule).
